)
SELECT ROUND(SUM(r.sr_return_amt) / SUM(j.ss_net_paid) * 100, 2) AS return_rate_pct,
       SUM(r.sr_return_amt) AS ret_amt,
       SUM(j.ss_net_paid) AS net_paid,
       COUNT(*) AS n_rows,

 AND j.ss_item_sk = r.sr_item_sk;
